d: Sky-blue hair is medium-length with choppy layers and long bangs sweeping across the forehead, paired with bright cerulean eyes and a cheerful expression. The face appears youthful and child-like, complemented by a petite build. The outfit consists of a dark navy sailor-style top with a white collar and a matching blue necktie adorned with a yellow crescent moon charm, worn over a dark navy pleated skirt with a light blue ruffled underskirt. A brown leather strap crosses the torso diagonally.
